definitions.gloss: air conditioning; climate control (HVAC, in buildings)
definitions.explanation: The general term for the equipment and systems that regulate the temperature, humidity, and circulation of air inside a building. Short for {空気調和|くうきちょうわ} ("air conditioning," literally "air harmonization"). {空調|くうちょう} typically refers to the whole system at a building or facility level — covering both heating and cooling — whereas the everyday loanword エアコン usually refers to a single residential unit.

examples.japanese: {空調|くうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いている→効く：01932_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioning is working well.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空調|くうちょう}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧。
examples.english: This building's HVAC equipment is old.

examples.english: Office-building air-conditioning systems are automatically controlled according to the season and usage conditions.

notes:
{空調|くうちょう} is a building-engineering term covering all aspects of climate control — heating, cooling, ventilation, and humidity. It is the standard word in Japanese architecture, building management, and engineering for what English speakers call "HVAC."

FORMS:
- Short form of {空気調和|くうきちょうわ} ("air harmonization")
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧ ("air") + ⟦{調和|ちょうわ}→調和：05216_chouwa⟧ ("harmony, balance") → {空気調和|くうきちょうわ} → {空調|くうちょう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空調|くうちょう}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧: HVAC equipment, climate control system
- {空調|くうちょう}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧: HVAC system
- {空調|くうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ / ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to turn the air conditioning on / off
- {空調|くうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: for the air conditioning to work / be effective
- {空調|くうちょう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: HVAC management
- {空調|くうちょう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: HVAC installation work
- {全館|ぜんかん}{空調|くうちょう}: whole-building air conditioning

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: air conditioner (loanword; more colloquial; usually a single residential unit)
- ⟦{冷房|れいぼう}→冷房：01755_reibou⟧: cooling, air conditioning (specifically the cooling function)
- ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧: heating
- ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧: ventilation (air exchange between inside and outside)
- ⟦{通気|つうき}→通気：27363_tsuuki⟧: ventilation, airflow (more passive than ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧)
- ⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧: humidity control
- ヒート⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧: heat pump

USAGE:
- {空調|くうちょう} sounds technical or institutional — used in offices, hospitals, factories, transit stations, and rental contracts. For your apartment in everyday speech, ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧ or ⟦{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}→冷暖房：28048_reidanbou⟧ sounds more natural.
- In job listings and building specifications, {全館|ぜんかん}{空調|くうちょう} ("central air conditioning throughout the building") is a selling point that goes beyond having window-mounted ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧ units in each room.
- Verbs that take {空調|くうちょう} as object: ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧, ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧, ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧, ⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ("to inspect"), ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧ ("to adjust").
